messages.text: I can't promise it will. It earns ANYONE tokens, and what they're worth goes up and down with the token price and the network, so I won't give you a payback date. What's drawing you to it?

I'll be straight with you, since it's your money. I don't have earnings figures for the Anyone Router, so I can't tell you it will earn back its $289. It earns $ANYONE tokens for sharing bandwidth, and what those are worth moves with the token price. It's also sold as Final Sale.

Most people buy it for the privacy side: it sets up an encrypted hotspot at home, and the tokens are extra on top. Does that privacy part matter to you, or are the tokens the main reason you're looking?
